# Materials — Application and software supply chain security / Rapid course / English

[Edition overview](README.md) · [Chapters](SUBJECTS.md) · [One principal book plan](book/PLAN.md) · [Supplementary playbooks](../../../../playbooks/application-supply-chain/README.md) · [Course skill](../skill/SKILL.md)

**Teaching and examples:** each subject-chapter belongs to the one principal book. Plans describe intended content; only the linked manuscript contains authored lessons.

**Labs and practice:** the published English manuscript contains two offline labs. Do not edit the scripts. The component print stays:

```text
donate-form     3.2.0  UPDATE to 3.2.4
event-calendar  1.4.1  UNMAINTAINED (1606 days since release)
photo-gallery   2.0.0  REMOVE (not in use)
newsletter      5.1.3  ok
```

The release print stays:

```text
[x] official source used
[x] hash matches vendor
[x] backup taken
[x] tested on staging copy
[ ] admin accounts use MFA
NOT READY: admin accounts use MFA
```

Use synthetic data only. Do not replace either print. The next morning's release is not a second script. Four true values out of five keys, and the ages 60, 103, and 30, are derivations, not lines in the output.

**Projects and assessment:** score the authored exercises with their 0–3 rubrics. Review of the edition is still open.

**Exercises and answers:** EX001–EX066 have worked results in the manuscript appendix. A planned quota is not an authored exercise. There is no exercise quota.

**References and glossary:** verifiable primary sources and clear terms belong in the authored manuscript; linked project playbooks retain their source rights.
